s: nurse; by extension used to refer to any medical staff that is not a doctor (usually, but not necessarily, confined to female staff)
nurse; used as a title of address for nurses
sister; nun; used particularly, but not only, as a title of address
Schwester.et:
From Middle High German swëster, from Old High German swëster, from Proto-Germanic *swestēr.
Compare Low German swester, Dutch zuster, English sister, Danish søster, Swedish syster.

s: a model that has the same basis as another
Der Opel Astra ist ein Schwestermodell vom Chevrolet Cruze.
The Opel Astra is a ? from the Chevrolet Cruze.
sister group or sibling group, a clade's closest relative
